title: EMOSA virtual agent configuration
description: One virtual EasyMesh agent for one OpenSync pod. Written by the fleet (or by hand); read by emosa-agent.

pod_id.description: Operation and journal scope; the fleet uses the serial.

serial.description: AWLAN_Node.serial_number the agent is bound to; any other pod is refused.

ovsdb.description: Where the pod's OVSDB connection arrives (passive, local only).

interface.description: The agent's own 1905.1 interface; its MAC is al_mac.

profile.description: Pod profile ID, or a path to a profile file.

uplink.description: Data plane option 1: the agent switches the pod's backhaul station onto the EasyMesh backhaul (data-plane.md §5.3, spec §8). Absent or mode off: the pod keeps its OpenSync uplink (option 2).

credentials.description: m2: the backhaul BSS of the controller's applied M2 set (multi_bss); config: ssid and secret_ref below.

secret_ref.description: A file in the agent's secret directory (state_dir/secrets), mode 0600.

bssid.description: The upstream backhaul BSS the station is pinned to, required with mode multi-ap. Never one of the pod's own BSSIDs: a station on its own backhaul BSS loops br-home.

telemetry.description: The pod's own statistics (spec §3.6): the agent sets the pod's MQTT settings and a raw client report once per OpenSync start, and subscribes to the pod's topic. Absent or mode off: the agent leaves the pod's statistics publishing alone.

broker.description: Broker host the pod connects to (mutual TLS with its device certificate).

subscribe.description: host:port where the agent reads the pod's topic.

steering.description: Client steering (spec §3.7): the controller's Client Steering Request mandates are carried out by the pod's owm, a steering window with a directed BTM kick. Absent: owm. Mode off: the requests are counted as unsupported and not acknowledged.

vif.description: Ignored; the fronthaul VIF comes from the profile.
